ca-06053-bos-matter-67153.title:
Adopt a resolution:
a. Increase the Maximum Filled Full-Time Equivalency (FTE) for the Department of Social Services by 25 FTE for a new departmental total of 845 FTE to meet the legal mandates of H.R.1 requirements for accessing benefits for the Medi-Cal Program; and 
b. Authorize the Human Resources Department to process hiring transactions consistent with the revised Department of Social Services Maximum Filled FTE limit and direct the Human Resources Department and the Auditor-Controller’s Office to implement the changes in the Advantage Human Resources Management (HRM) System; and 
c. Direct the County Administrative Office to update the official Maximum Filled FTE table following Board approval; and
d. Authorize and direct the Auditor-Controller to amend the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Adopted Social Services Budget Fund 1001, Department 501007 to increase revenues by $7,082,428 and to increase appropriations by $6,008,943 in account category 60000, and $1,073,485 in account category 62925, for a total appropriation increase of $7,082,428 to provide Medi-Cal funding for administrative support (4/5ths vote required).
